optimizer: AdamW, reset between stages; no optimizer state transfer
word_target: Exact exported word strings, unchanged case and punctuation; one-hot class targets from fold-training words only; no external text model or target embedding fit
word_loss: Cross entropy over all fold-training word classes, including missing EEG slots
sentence_loss: Full-candidate cross entropy against unchanged sentence embeddings, cosine logits / 0.07
transfer: Only 841x32 projection weight and 32 bias; discard word head; GRU and sentence head retain shared initial weights
budget: Pretrained arms: 128 word updates + 256 sentence updates. Equal-step fresh baseline: 128 sentence updates, reset AdamW, then 256 sentence updates. Same-sentence fresh baseline: 256 sentence updates. Matching is by optimizer updates, not FLOPs or word/sentence counts; word batches have 256 slots and sentence batches up to 64 sequences.
checkpoint_rule: Only the final checkpoint of each fixed stage; no epoch selection, early stopping or search
oov: Vocabulary fits fold-training labels only. Every held-out word retained; OOV predictions count as misses with reciprocal rank zero. All sentence observations retained.
missingness: Retain all missing word slots; scaled training-mean zero EEG plus observed-word indicator. Preserve all-missing sentences and use packed true lengths to exclude padding.
scope: Eight original training readers, leave one reader out. No outer-validation or test EEG access or evaluation under any outcome.
stopping: Stop after the fixed training-CV comparison. No expansion after outcomes.
